registryEntry.label: Defender Firewall Port Policy: firewall on, inbound blocked by default (Intune)
registryEntry.set_command: $created = Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri 'https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations' -Body (@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.windows10EndpointProtectionConfiguration';displayName='CMMC-Firewall-PortPolicy';description='CMMC CM.L2-3.4.7[i]: Defender Firewall on and inbound connections blocked by default on the domain, private and public profiles; only explicitly allowed ports open';firewallBlockStatefulFTP=$true;firewallProfileDomain=@{firewallEnabled='allowed';inboundConnectionsBlocked=$true};firewallProfilePrivate=@{firewallEnabled='allowed';inboundConnectionsBlocked=$true};firewallProfilePublic=@{firewallEnabled='allowed';inboundConnectionsBlocked=$true}} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json'; Invoke-MgGraphRequest -Method POST -Uri "https://graph.microsoft.us/v1.0/deviceManagement/deviceConfigurations/$($created.id)/assign" -Body (@{assignments=@(@{target=@{'@odata.type'='#microsoft.graph.groupAssignmentTarget';groupId='{cuiGroupId}'}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10) -ContentType 'application/json' | Out-Null; $created | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10
